text:
marta: Heads-up  we need a crisp artifact mapping routing tiers to launch gates, pricing, and migration constraints for Q4 roadmap. Sales is pushing for simple demo language. Ops wants hard rollback guarantees.

lucas: Agreed. I'd like to see four tiers in the one-pager: shard (baseline), geo-guard (residency + soft-affinity), quarantine-lane (strict residency, limited burst), and tenant-island (full dedicated capacity). The quarantine-lane is a new ask from customers in regulated verticals.

ryan: For each tier we should list: p50/p95/p99 SLOs, burst-cap (tokens/sec), allowed egress flags, KV policy (local/peeking/disabled), required contract, and the eviction/rollback SLA.

sara: Customers explicitly asked for an "eviction SLA" wording  they want to know how long a tenant might be throttled or moved during incidents. Sales needs clear commitment language for demos.

lucas: Operational note: quarantine-lane should default to no peeking and a strict burst cap. Allow peeking only via explicit opt-in and add an egress cost multiplier. We should publish a sample cost table for sales.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: policy-lab canary started (id: lab-314). Logs: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/lab-314

marta: Draft launch gates I'm proposing: 1) policy DSL + lint + unit tests; 2) telemetry widgets + per-tenant cost calc; 3) pilot tenants (3-7) for each tier; 4) migration playbook with soft-evict <2hr; 5) legal/regulatory sign-off for quarantine-lane; 6) sales demo copy + pricing matrix.

ryan: Add mandatory chaos sims for quarantine-lane and tenant-island (slow-link, cross-region partition). Require rollback path to regional-compatible model within 20 minutes. For tenant-island, require Reserved Capacity commit before cutover.

sara: For demo copy, suggest a single toggle: "Provider Isolation: Off / Quarantine / Dedicated" with short tooltips and explicit % uplift ranges. Sales wants a simple table: tier -> typical uplift (low/med/high).

lucas: We should also include a minimal policy snippet for the one-pager so engineering can validate CLI examples. Keep DSL compact. Example for quarantine-lane: 

```
policy: quarantine-lane
affinity: hard-residency
kv_cache: region-local
burst_cap_tokens_per_s: 80
peeking_allowed: false
fallback: region-compatible-quant
sla_p99_ms: 150
```

marta: Nice. Also call out that certain jurisdictions require signed data residency appendix before activation. That must be a gate in the checklist.

ryan: Operational constraint: cross-region traffic for peeking increases egress and can add 30-60ms on p99 in our sims. We'll include a note and an estimated egress multiplier.

sara: Sales follow-up: can we offer a per-region minimum monthly commit for tenant-island to make pricing predictable? They want a template contract term for SDRs.

marta: Action items: marta -> one-pager with tier table, launch gates, DSL snippet, and pricing matrix draft; ryan -> migration playbook + chaos test checklist + p99 delta numbers; lucas -> sample cost multipliers for peeking vs strict-local; sara -> demo toggle copy and sales contract template. Reconvene Thu 9am PT.

lucas: One last ask  keep the DSL intentionally narrow for v1 to reduce coupling. Defaults should be conservative.

marta: Agreed. v1 defaults: no peeking, region-local cache, clear fallback to quantized regional variants. Posting draft by Tue EOD.

sara: Thanks everyone, this feels actionable. :rocket:
